        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"markdown\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("# Hello\n\nWorld", config);
